HALLUCINATIONS:
- The memo states, "Borrower maintains full compliance with all existing covenants and representations." The source only requires, as a condition to effectiveness, that (i) there is no Default or Event of Default at the time and immediately after the First Amendment Effective Date and (ii) representations and warranties are true and correct in all material respects as of that date. It does not assert ongoing full compliance with all covenants and representations.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS:
- Non-Designated Issuance prepayment waterfall: 100% of Net Cash Proceeds must (1) first prepay Loans within 5 Business Days until no Loans remain outstanding under the Delayed Draw Term Loan Facility, and (2) then any remaining Net Cash Proceeds automatically reduce the Commitments, applied ratably between the Acquisition Tranche Commitments and the General Tranche Commitments.

{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["Inconsistent threshold description: Risks section says borrower can retain proceeds above the $500 million threshold, while Deal Terms state retention is allowed only if loans remain \u2264 $500,000,000 outstanding.", "Designated Issuance prepayment terms conflict internally: it says Net Cash Proceeds must be applied within 1 Business Day, yet also says the borrower may retain proceeds if loans remain \u2264 $500,000,000 (cannot both prepay and retain the same proceeds without an explicit exception)."]}
